root_cause.text: In ovl_iterate_merged(), the return variable err is assigned PTR_ERR(cache) before checking IS_ERR(cache), causing a valid cache pointer to be misinterpreted as a non-zero error code that is later returned on success.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states: "ovl_iterate_merged() stores PTR_ERR(cache) in err before checking IS_ERR(cache). On success err holds the truncated cache pointer and can be returned as a bogus non-zero error." The patch fixes this by moving the PTR_ERR() call inside the error branch and returning 0 at the end.
